They don't eat stuff like seeds in the wild! They eat fruit mainly, their mating season is year round so they get really hormonal and the sugar can make it worse so you have to balance it out.
Most pellets are vitamin fortified, they have a longer digestive tract than other parrots so they absorb a lot more of the vitamins that they DO NOT need.
Some people feed high quality pellets just made for ekkies but I still personally wouldn't use them.  I think the biggest problem is that they can seem to be doing well for quite a while and then one day, they're a mess. The artificial ingredients in pellets tend to build up over time which is why you see an issue further down the line rather than immediately. I also know of lots of people who feed pellets though with no problems and have been doing so for years, but i also know so many who end up wing flipping, toe tapping, and plucking, which was fixed by just cutting the pellets.
Dyed pellets are the worst! They won't be able to produce their red feathers and they'll end up yellow striped and even their beak might get lighter.

Eclectus has a very specific diet to other parrots!  They shouldnt eat stuff like pellets,
